symptom: `$m = find $l by System.owner = $User;` (filter, System.changedBy alike) was refused at exec with `member "System.owner" on entity Shop.Owned is not a known association … create the association first`, though mxbuild builds it; describe printed a stored one as `find $l by owner`, and a System association inherited by Administration.Account as `by User_Language`, which re-executed as the attribute Administration.Account.User_Language — CE1613 (ako/mxcli#1629, 11.12.5)
cause: Two halves of one gap. resolveMemberChange looks the qualifier's module up in its domain model, and System's virtual model has no owner/changedBy (they are root-entity flags). extractFieldName cut every member to its last segment, and the builder resolves a bare name in the LIST ENTITY'S module, so any association outside it — System's included — came back as something else
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (resolveMemberChange resolves System.owner/changedBy, refuses another case as CE1613), `mdl/executor/validate_list_operation_system_member.go` (CE0091 when the root stores no such member, reference tier), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_format_action.go` (extractFieldName keeps System associations qualified), `mdl/executor/flow_member_spelling.go` (the speller spells a find's member with extractFieldName)
insight: Describe and the member speller are two answers to 'how is this member spelled' — change one and the other must take the same function, or diff-then-patch compares unlike spellings. The phantom rewrite that causes is INVISIBLE end to end: write elision reports 'Unchanged' because the rebuilt BSON is identical, so a re-run test passed with the speller reverted; only a direct describedMemberSpellings test caught it (over a System.User list, where the bare name does resolve). Measured (11.12.5): find/filter by System.owner|changedBy clean iff the chain root stores it, else CE0091 'No member selected.' — a third CE code for the same 'entity does not store it' fact (CE0161 in XPath, CE1050 for any create/change). Sibling NOT fixed: a find by another module's association (`Other.Emp_Dept` over an HR list) still describes bare and re-executes as HR's — flow_member_spelling_test already names it as a control
